source.attribution: Course-authored controlled Standard Albanian. Drafted by an AI model; not yet reviewed by a native speaker.
source.provenance: Drafted by an AI model for the course; not reviewed by a native speaker. It is controlled, deliberately repetitive Standard Albanian written for learners and may contain unnatural or incorrect phrasing. Every word form was checked by machine against the course's own word list, the UniParser Albanian analyzer and Wiktionary's Albanian tables (npm run sq:check-texts); that is a check of forms, not of naturalness, and forms on which those sources differ are listed in data/review/sq/accepted-differences.json. The English lines are the drafter's own.

sentences.text: Në darkë familja është në shtëpi.
sentences.english: At dinner the family is at home.

sentences.text: Ai është i lodhur, por i lumtur.

sentences.english: The mother has made the dinner.
Everyone sits down at the table.
"How was the day?" asks the father.

sentences.text: — Mësuesi na dha një libër të ri.
sentences.english: "The teacher gave us a new book."

sentences.text: — Unë i shkrova gjyshes, — thotë Ana.
sentences.english: "I wrote to the grandmother," says Ana.
After dinner, the children wash the plates.
